subject: Q3–Q4 Budget & OKR alignment: scenario orchestration and timelines
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3–Q4 Budget & OKR alignment: scenario orchestration and timelines

Team —

We need to kick off the budgeting/OKR alignment work for the second half of the year. Goals here are twofold: (1) land realistic spend + headcount targets that match our product roadmap and Dedicated/Private sales motion, and (2) produce two scenario packages (Base / Constrained) that we can present at the April 29 leadership sync and the May 6 ops review.

High-level asks:
- Finance (Markus): please convert the baseline run-rate from Q1–Q2 into a Q3–Q4 baseline by end of day Wednesday (14 Apr). Include detailed spend buckets (infra, team opex, SRE/observability, cloud marketplace fees).
- Product (Laura): draft OKR targets that reflect the following priorities — Hosted product margins, Dedicated capacity retention, Private deployment pipeline. One page per team with measurable signals (latency SLO, cost per 1k tokens, #Dedicated seats). Due Friday (16 Apr).
- GTM (Vivek): sketch top 3 scenarios for pricing/discounting impact on renewals and new committed capacity (Conservative / Base / Aggressive). Quick numbers by Thursday (15 Apr).

I've attached the baseline workbook and a quick OKR template. I propose these milestones:
- 14 Apr: finance baseline spreadsheet returned
- 16 Apr: product OKR drafts due
- 19 Apr: consolidation + dry run with core execs
- 29 Apr: leadership sync (final scenarios)

Please reply with any blockers. If you're short on time, flag the specific cell/range you can't supply and we'll reassign.

Thanks —
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Strategy & Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2027_budget_baseline_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB); okr_targets-draft.md (text, 6KB)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3–Q4 Budget & OKR alignment: scenario orchestration and timelines

Evelyn —

Attached is the first pass of a Q3–Q4 baseline. I pulled Q1–Q2 actuals and projected a conservative growth to cover Dedicated onboarding costs. Highlights / caveats:
- Infra: projected +18% due to Dedicated capacity warm-up and pre-provisioning for expected customers in H2.
- Headcount: hiring freeze through mid-June on non-critical ICs; hiring for SRE + Observability recommended.
- Marketplace fees: flagged a potential vendor pass-through that could increase unit costs ~3%.

I'll add a column for scenario adjustments (taxes, reserved capacity discounts) and share by EOD Thursday.

Markus
VP Finance & Ops

Attachment: 2027_budget_baseline_v1_markus_notes.xlsx (spreadsheet, 57KB)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3–Q4 Budget & OKR alignment: scenario orchestration and timelines

Evelyn / Markus —

Attached are the draft OKR pages for Product, Platform, and Developer Experience. Quick notes:
- Product OKRs focus on retention of Dedicated customers (NPS target + 2 pts), and two growth levers: pricing tiers for Dedicated and a Private deployment onboarding playbook.
- Platform OKRs include latency SLOs (99th pctl < 220ms for gen workloads), and a quality metric: model regression escape rate < 0.5% per release.
- DevX OKRs centre on time-to-first-query for new customers (< 10 min) and better onboarding docs (page completion & checklist).

I left placeholders for metrics that need finance inputs (cost per 1k tokens, CAC credit assumptions).

Laura
Director, Product Management

Attachments: okr_targets-draft_v1.md (document, 9KB)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3–Q4 Budget & OKR alignment: scenario orchestration and timelines

Team —

Attached is a short scenario sketch. Summary:
- Conservative: hold pricing, reduce marketing spend, focus on renewals — growth +4% vs base, minimal Dedicated uptake.
- Base: moderate discounts for committed Dedicated capacity, healthy new logos from marketplace partnerships — growth +12%.
- Aggressive: strategic discounts + expanded private offering with sales incentives — growth +22% but requires +12% headcount.

Request: Markus, can you run sensitivity on margin impact for each scenario (2x and 3x discount bands)? That will help us prioritize headcount in scenario planning.

Vivek
VP Sales, Americas

Attachment: okr_pricing_scenarios_abridged.pdf (pdf, 84KB)
From: Sara Dunne <sara.dunne@figtech.com>

Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 10:09:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Q3–Q4 Budget & OKR alignment: scenario orchestration and timelines

Evelyn —

Appreciate the heads-up — FigTech is running its annual budgeting cycle this month as well. Two quick datapoints that might be useful for your scenarios:
- We see a ~7% uplift in committed capacity when vendors offer 6–12 month price guarantees vs ad-hoc consumption.
- Our procurement team requires a clear rollout plan for private/on-prem offers before committing to multi-year contracts.

Happy to share anonymized benchmarking data; cc'd is finance-benchmarks@consults.co who can send the dataset if useful. Good luck with the run.

—Sara
Sara Dunne
VP, Procurement | FigTech
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Q3–Q4 Budget & OKR alignment: scenario orchestration and timelines

Thanks all — solid progress. Quick next steps:
- Markus: please upload the sensitivity matrix for the three scenarios to the Drive folder by Monday 19 Apr COB.
- Laura: iterate OKRs with the now-attached finance placeholders and mark any hard dependencies (hiring, infra spend) inline in the doc.
- Vivek: prioritize the Base scenario as the primary narrative for the leadership sync; include a one-slide summary of channel assumptions.

I will schedule a 60-minute consolidation call for Monday 19 Apr @ 10:00 PT; calendar invite to follow. Planning note: we should aim to keep the slides to 6–8 pages for the leadership sync.

Evelyn
